reason: My buyers come from referrals and have never asked to see a home before it's built. I sell with photos of finished homes, and I do 1-6 homes a year, so this is a nice extra I don't need.
objection: What happens every time the client changes the plan? Two revision rounds won't cover my clients. And if a render shows something that differs from what gets built, I'm the one they come back to, whatever the label says.
would_change_my_mind: A client of mine asking for it, or seeing it win a job from a past client or an architect I work with, plus clear terms on how plan changes after the two rounds are charged.
